Independently computed exact coefficients and 80 random finite rational reconstruction trials support critical algebra.

value.rationale: Cubic/quartic normalized cardinal spline coefficient recovery is a natural inverse-filtering problem. Here all knot derivatives up to continuity degree yield exact unit-conditioned sampling and *local* finite support coefficient recovery, rather than an implicit recursive inverse; the weights are rigorously unique among diagonal constant designs. Cubic slope observations provably do not fix the Nyquist loss, while curvature does. This structural necessity and exact optimization are significant within the standard spline spaces despite the finite-degree restriction.
